cvText.title: CV / Resume Text
cvText.description: Paste the full text of your CV or resume. The agent will use this to match and rate job listings.

jobTitle.title: Job Title to Search
jobTitle.description: The job title or keywords to search for on Glassdoor (e.g. 'Software Engineer', 'Data Scientist'). If left empty, the agent will extract a suitable title from your CV.

location.title: Location
location.description: City, state, or country where you want to find jobs (e.g. 'New York, NY', 'Remote', 'United Kingdom').

maxJobs.title: Maximum Number of Jobs
maxJobs.description: The maximum number of job listings to retrieve and evaluate.

daysBack.title: Days Back (Job Freshness)
daysBack.description: Only include jobs posted within this many days. Defaults to 30 (roughly one month). If fewer than 5 jobs are found within this window the agent will automatically expand the search.

minMatchScore.title: Minimum Match Score
minMatchScore.description: Only include jobs whose AI match score is at least this value (0–10). Set to 0 to include all jobs.

openAiApiKey.title: OpenAI API Key
openAiApiKey.description: Your OpenAI API key, used to analyse job descriptions and rate their match with your CV.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy Configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Optional Apify proxy configuration for scraping Glassdoor.
